notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/productoverview.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/productoverview.md at 6d52ca8. The guide's Sources note was checked on 20 October 2026 on the 19 October build of Biscuit's main, the build the evidence names (mirror v0.1.78-c7d3348, Biscuit's main at c7d3348), so items citing the note or the evidence carry that build. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c7d3348 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 changes ProductOverview (built lib and ProductOverview.d.ts), apparently with Component Bug #355's fix; ProductLabel, Image and react-utils are unchanged. Installed ProductOverview.tsx and ProductLabel.tsx still match most guide sentences used here, read from source, not run (token values through the package's own resolver): a white panel (productOverview/background #ffffff), 24 px padding, 12 px gap, no radius or border, width 100% of the host, everything centred; the picture only with imageSource, at imageRatio (default 288/170), resizeMode contain; the chip is a ProductLabel that always renders, with a 29 px round Avatar only when labelImageSource is set; the name 26 px heavy, a header (accessibilityRole header); the description 14 px, centred; children cloned with the card's modes between the description and the stats; stats in equal flex-1 columns, a 20 px value over a 12 px label, each one line ending in … unless disableTruncation, and [] removes the row; the root is a View with no onPress and no selected, disabled or loading prop; Text Appearance changes text/appearance/high/color, which colours the name and the stat labels (Neutral #000000, Primary gold #cea15a, Secondary purple #5d00b5, Tertiary blue #026b9a, Success, Warning, Error), not the description or the stat values (#141414). Where the guide states the problems of #355, the installed source contradicts three of them, and they are not encoded: (1) the description is no longer white on white: ProductOverview.tsx lines 99–103 read card/supportive-text/color, which resolves to #1a1c1f (Figma's Text/Medium) in all seven Text Appearance modes; text/appearance/medium/color itself is still white in all seven but no longer read. So the Sources sentence “The description’s colour token is white in every Text Appearance mode, so the description can’t be read on the white card”, the anatomy note “it renders white on white today” and the playground readout are out of date for the package (the published Storybook, built 17 October, still shows the old card). The Description part takes only “description, 14 px, centred”. (2) the picture no longer fills the card's width: lines 195–213 wrap the Image in a View 288 px wide (maxWidth 100%, aspectRatio imageRatio, centred), so at Figma's 343 px the picture is Figma's 288 × 170, centred, and only a card narrower than 336 px shrinks it. Sources “The package’s picture fills the card’s width (Figma’s is 288 × 170, centred)” and Sizing “The picture fills the width inside 24 px of padding, so a wider card has a taller picture” are out of date; the configuration rule says “fitted inside the card's width”, which holds. With the 288 × 170 picture the card is about 405 px tall at 343 (the copy snapshot itself renders “343 × 405”), not “about 409”. (3) disableTruncation no longer affects only the stats: lines 226 and 233 give the name one line and the description two lines, each ending in …, unless disableTruncation is set, as the d.ts JSDoc (the props:disableTruncation fact) says; so Sources “disableTruncation affects only the stats” and Sizing “The name and description wrap.” are out of date, and the configuration item rests on the fact. Evidence lines out of date the same way, not used: the picture's width: 100%, the never-truncated name and description, the description's token, 343 × ~409 with a 295 × 174 picture, the mdx truncation discrepancy, and “A Badge there keeps its own alignSelf: flex-start and sits at the left” (lines 178–180 and 238–240 now centre children with alignSelf center). Still present on dbe0e02, kept as gaps with the 20 October build: the taller text lines (safeTextLineHeight raises the name's 26 px token to 32 and a stat value's 20 to 24, #355) and the published Storybook (index.json last modified 17 October 2026, checked 29 October; #355). The Figma-vs-code gaps (Figma has no properties; no children, imageRatio or disableTruncation; no picture or chip picture by default in code) still match the installed props and defaults; Figma itself was not re-checked. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every ProductOverview, VStack and Button), no maxWidth style (the guide caps its specimens at 343 px for the page), no Text Appearance (no guide sentence says which content needs it; its configuration facts are kept as rules), the In context VStack's Slot gap M is left out, and the Buy Button's style alignSelf stretch is dropped (VStack stretches its children by default). The guide's pictures are docs assets (gold-coin.png, Figma's own coin, and jio-gold-logo.png); the examples pass { uri } sources that stand for the product's own picture and the brand's logo, as the ProfileCard entry does. Copy is the guide's own (Gold, 5g Gold Coin, the insured-delivery description, 995 Purity, 3% GST, Silver, 10g Silver Coin, 999, 10g Weight, Buy for ₹38,750). Left out of examples (three at most): the playground and its readout, Picture, No picture, Three stats, imageRatio 2, No chip picture, the two Text Appearance cards, Read-only, the hosts and Long stats, and the Don'ts. Not recorded: style (the building rules keep style off Coin components); the modes the evidence says change the chip or do nothing (Page type, Avatar Size, Context2, Context4, Context, Badge Size, context 10, Profile Card Appearance), which its Limits keep out of the guide; the picture's hidden-from-screen-readers detail (the guide doesn't state it) and dark mode (the pack's rules); Biscuit's handwritten ProductOverview.mdx (not for a buy button on the summary, or a campaign photo), since the guide doesn't say it and that page isn't deployed, so avoidWhen holds only the guide's missing states and press. The Sources blocks that end “jfs-components”, “0.1.78”, “disableTruncation” are the note's code elements; the paragraph renders whole, so no value is missing.

    imageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/gold-coin.png' }}
    labelImageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/jio-gold-logo.png' }}
    label="Gold"
    productName="5g Gold Coin"
    description="Your gold is insured from our vault to you. If lost or damaged, we’ll replace it."
    stats={[

      { value: '3%', label: 'GST' },
    ]}

</VStack>
